name: Zoom Light Screen
description: Adjustable-color full-screen light for video calls — dial in the perfect color temperature to look natural on camera.

name: Ring Light Screen
description: Create a custom-colored glow ring around your webcam window — softer than a solid fill and mimics a physical ring light.

name: Screen Flashlight
description: Instant max-brightness white fill — turns your screen into a portable flashlight for finding things in the dark.

name: Broken Screen Dummy
description: Convincing cracked-screen overlays — pick from spiderweb, shatter, glitch, or LCD bleed styles to prank a friend.

name: Fake Update Screen
description: Classic Windows, macOS, or Linux-style fake update screens — lock the display and watch coworkers think you're updating.

name: No Signal Screen
description: Animated TV static with a bouncing NO SIGNAL overlay — convincing enough to make someone check the cables.

name: Dead Pixel Test
description: Cycle through full-screen colors to spot dead or stuck pixels — includes a rapid-flash mode that can sometimes fix them.

name: Screen Cleaner
description: Input-locked white or black screen so you can safely wipe your display without triggering random clicks or taps.

name: Countdown Timer Fullscreen
description: Large full-screen countdown timer over a solid background — great for presentations, test-taking, or cooking timers.
